subject: Matemática e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Resolver e elaborar problemas do cotidiano, da Matemática e de outras áreas do conhecimento, que envolvem equações lineares simultâneas, usando técnicas algébricas e gráficas, com ou sem apoio de tecnologias digitais.

components.description_pt: Criar sistema de equações lineares em contexto do mundo real, incluindo representação de restrições
components.description_en: Create a system of linear equations in a real-world context, including representing constraints in the context
components.cc_component_description: Create a system of linear equations in a real-world context, including representing constraints in the context

components.description_pt: Resolver sistemas de equações lineares algebricamente
components.description_en: Solve systems of linear equations algebraically
components.cc_component_description: Solve systems of linear equations algebraically

components.description_pt: Interpretar solução de sistema de equações lineares no contexto do problema original
components.description_en: Interpret the solution of a system of linear equations in the context of the original problem
components.cc_component_description: Interpret mathematical results in the context of the original real-world situation

components.description_pt: Formular problemas de outras áreas de conhecimento que podem ser resolvidos com sistemas lineares
components.description_en: Formulate problems from other areas of knowledge that can be solved using systems of linear equations
components.cc_component_description: Solve real-world problems leading to systems of linear equations

cc_matches.description: Solve systems of two linear equations in two variables algebraically, and estimate solutions by graphing the equations. Solve simple cases by inspection. *For example, 3x + 2y = 5 and 3x + 2y = 6 have no solution because 3x + 2y cannot simultaneously be 5 and 6.*

Represent constraints by equations or inequalities, and by systems of equations and/or inequalities, and interpret solutions as viable or nonviable options in a modeling context. *For example, represent inequalities describing nutritional and cost constraints on combinations of different foods.*

Solve real-world and mathematical problems leading to two linear equations in two variables. *For example, given coordinates for two pairs of points, determine whether the line through the first pair of points intersects the line through the second pair.*
